name: q3-rl-autonomy-20260911
scope: Q3 only; CPU-only policy research; no official simulator interaction
policy_expectation: Learn whether a proposed action is worthwhile given observation history and its effect on whole-episode cost; neither recurrent memory nor RL alone proves global optimality.
initial_checkpoint_selection: Best of the three already completed old CPU development endpoints on their original development set; report all three, not a new independent superiority claim
partition_rules: Training variants share the same per-replication scenario sequence where budget permits. Development may guide decisions. Confirmation requires a frozen model. Do not reuse confirmation to tune and call it independent. Final and stress are opened only after model selection is frozen.
official_database: Entire practice_training.sqlite3 is validation only; no imitation, distribution fitting, normalization fitting, or invented counterfactual feedback
variants_planned: Unchanged base-action PPO continued from the selected endpoint
Additional useful localization probe candidates, policy-selected
Current-position or bounded target-position discovery measurements, policy-selected
Recurrent policy trained on actual observation sequences with correct episode resets
experiment_rules: Implement and audit mechanisms before large runs. Compare zero-additional-training candidate behavior and matched-budget continued base PPO. Retain all training seeds and endpoint outcomes. New mechanisms must be separately versioned and frozen. An added candidate set may change initial probabilities; do not claim lossless migration unless verified.

cpu.resource_scope: Entire inherited process affinity, including sampling, optimization, evaluation and result synchronization; concurrency settings are not additive permission to exceed the cap

lower_bound.primary: L/5+5N, original physical oracle relaxation; L from exact clearance-disk graph subset DP
lower_bound.aggregation: sum(actual time)/sum(case lower bound), also retain each case ratio
lower_bound.caveat: Not an achievable unknown-scene online optimum; no denominator switching

acceptance.tradeoff_policy: A mean/tail tradeoff remains a conditional candidate; do not call it an unconditional upgrade

artifact_rules: Only versioned project code and anonymous generated results in dedicated storage folder; no credentials, account identifiers or unrelated files. Risky operations need user confirmation. Never delete initial branches or unarchived work.
stop_rules: Continue meaningful evidence-led exploration until the deadline, verified plateau across investigated mechanisms, or account remaining quota <=1%. No reset credits. Explain untested directions and distinguish resource limits from theoretical optimality.
